scope: AsyncWrap before/snapshot/InternalMakeCallback/after order and post-callback native lifetime
review: Trace.before receives the actual live State and runs before provider/context snapshots; the native trace implementation remains responsible for gating before async-ID read.
The call retains its existing Environment through InternalMakeCallback, native after emission and result handoff. No guest callback is introduced by trace or lifetime admission.
Provider and async context are saved before InternalMakeCallback. Static after receives only the saved provider/id and never dereferences State, which guest callback teardown may destroy.
After runs for ordinary return, empty MaybeLocal and failed native/guest completion. Failure is recorded in the same caller boundary before the native after operation.

Caller Scope owns the actual resource/receiver/context-frame handles. InternalMakeCallback's owned return is admitted to that same Scope only after after emission; Scope admission has its existing failure release path.
Trace operations are mandatory and have no default-disabled substitute; native category admission/controller/writer installation remains separate.
